VI.description: Shares a window of another program in a web browser and returns right away\3A the front panel of a LabVIEW-built application or of another LabVIEW version\2C or the window of any other program.\0A\0Awindow is the window handle (HWND). RemoteVI Server lists the windows you can share. port\2C whole network?\2C token\2C view only? and URL work as in RemoteVI Start.vi.\0A\0AThe browser gets the picture\2C clicks\2C keys\2C menus and popups of the window\2C and the dialogs of that program. Shift\2C Ctrl and Alt\2C tip strips and splitter bars also need VI Server in the shared LabVIEW application\3B see the VI Server input.\0A\0AThe share ends when you call RemoteVI Stop.vi with the same port or when the window closes.
